raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was partly re-delivered at 2026-01-17 22:00, alongside its normal 02:00 load, so about 20 txn_ids appear twice in raw_transactions. The txn_id range 900001–904866 is contiguous with exactly 4866 distinct values, so these are re-sent copies of existing transactions, not new ones; silver_transactions does not deduplicate, which double-counts them in silver and all gold tables. The fix keeps only the latest-ingested version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, so if a later version is REVERSED the transaction drops out.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
